He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Boston College Eagles men's basketball|Boston College Eagles]]. He is an 6'5 guard who was not ranked by ESPN in the high school recruiting class of 2015.{{Cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/college-sports/basketball/recruiting/player/_/id/203561/jerome-robinson|title=Jerome Robinson - Basketball Recruiting - Player Profiles - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=April 4, 2018}} As an freshman he averaged 11.7 points, 4 rebounds and 3 assists per game, then 18.7 points, 4 rebounds, 3.4 assists per game as an sophomore. As an junior he averaged 20.7 points, 3.6 rebounds and 3.3 assists per game and was named All [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] First Team with 14 [[Atlantic Coast Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|ACC POY]] votes.{{Cite news|url=http://www.theacc.com/news/2018/3/4/mens-basketball-acc-announces-all-conference-team-postseason-awards.aspx|title=ACC Announces All-Conference Team, Postseason Awards|access-date=April 4, 2018}} After the season he declared for the [[2018 NBA draft]] but did not hire an agent to preserve his collegiate eligibility.{{cite news|last1=Weitzer|first1=Nate|title=BC’s Jerome Robinson and Ky Bowman declare for NBA Draft|url=https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/colleges/2018/04/04/jerome-robinson-and-bowman-declare-for-nba-draft/548XAy60JO2wqe0UeHixeP/story.html|accessdate=April 5, 2018|work=[[Boston Globe]]|date=April 5, 2018}} On April 28, 2018 he hired an agent with CAA sports thus ending his eligibility.{{cite web|title=Jerome Robinson to stay in NBA Draft|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/usa/nba/272747/jerome-robinson-to-stay-in-nba-draft.html|website=Sportando|accessdate=April 29, 2018|date=April 28, 2018}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://bceagles.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=9656 Boston College Eagles bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Robinson, Jerome}} [[Category:1997 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from North Carolina]] [[Category:Boston College Eagles men's basketball players]] [[Category:Needham B.
